concepts.definition: The national NPI facility identifier assigned by the National Pollutant Inventory, unique across all jurisdictions. Identifies the facility across snapshots; it is not the operator's ABN/ACN.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.establishment.source_key is a generic publisher site code; the NPI national facility identifier is a distinct, nationally unique key that must not be conflated with the state-scoped jurisdiction_facility_id, so a dedicated concept preserves the correct identity semantics.

concepts.definition: The state/territory-scoped NPI facility identifier. Only unique within its jurisdiction_code, so it must always be qualified by the jurisdiction and never used alone as a key.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept captures a jurisdiction-scoped facility identifier; ext.establishment.source_key is a single publisher code and would lose the required jurisdiction qualifier.

concepts.definition: The Australian state or territory code under which the NPI registers the facility (e.g. QLD, SA, WA, NSW). Qualifies the jurisdiction-scoped facility identifier.
concepts.why_not_existing: address.state is the business's address state; the NPI jurisdiction code is the facility's registration jurisdiction and is a required qualifier for the jurisdiction-scoped facility id, so it needs its own establishment-owned concept.

concepts.definition: The ANZSIC class code the NPI states as the facility's primary activity classification. Describes the facility, not the company-wide industry.
concepts.why_not_existing: entity.industry_code and ext.entity.industry_code are business-owned and company-wide; the NPI value is a facility-level primary classification and must not be promoted to the operator.

concepts.definition: The ANZSIC class name the NPI states for the facility's primary activity classification, in the publisher's wording.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds a facility-level ANZSIC class label; ext.entity.sector_tag is business-owned and scheme-qualified for other purposes.

concepts.definition: The source-stated free-text description of the facility's main activities (e.g. 'Pig Farming', 'WINEMAKING'). Kept in the publisher's wording; not an invented industry code.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.entity.sector_tag is a business-owned scheme tag; this is a facility-level free-text activity statement that must remain verbatim and establishment-owned.

concepts.definition: The NPI reporting-year label (e.g. '2003/2004') of the facility's first NPI report. A reporting-year label, not an incorporation or licence date.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds an NPI reporting-year label; ext.entity.date_established and entity.date_registered are business dates and must not be conflated with reporting years.

concepts.definition: The NPI reporting-year label (e.g. '2024/2025') of the facility's most recent NPI report. A reporting-year label, not a compliance or licence date.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds an NPI reporting-year label; it is distinct from first_report_year and from any business date concept.

concepts.definition: The number of NPI reports the facility has submitted, as stated by the source. A count of reports, not an emissions measure or compliance indicator.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.establishment.capacity counts patrons; no existing concept holds a facility's NPI report count, and it must not be read as an emissions quantity.

concepts.definition: The NPI identifier of the facility's most recent report, as published. Identifies the report, not the facility.
concepts.why_not_existing: No existing concept holds an NPI report identifier; it is distinct from the facility identifier and from the report URL.

concepts.definition: The published URL of the facility's most recent NPI report. A link only; it embeds state/year/jurisdiction-facility path segments and is not a stable facility identifier.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.contact.website_domain holds a registrable host, not a full report URL; no existing concept captures a report link, and it must not be treated as an identifier.

concepts.definition: The street address line of the NPI facility site as published (e.g. 'Hermann Thumm Drive', 'CNR BUSSELL HWY & BOUNDARY ROAD'). A site address, not the operator's registered office.
concepts.why_not_existing: address.full is business-owned and would assert the operator's address; the NPI street address describes the facility site, so it needs an establishment-owned concept.

concepts.definition: The suburb/locality of the NPI facility site as published. A site locality, not the operator's registered locality.
concepts.why_not_existing: address.locality is business-owned; the NPI suburb describes the facility site location and must not be promoted to the operator's address.

concepts.definition: The Australian state or territory of the NPI facility site address as published. A site address state, distinct from the NPI registration jurisdiction code.
concepts.why_not_existing: address.state is business-owned; the NPI state describes the facility site address and must not be conflated with the operator's address state or with dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_code.

concepts.definition: The 4-digit Australian postcode of the NPI facility site address as published.
concepts.why_not_existing: address.postcode is business-owned; the NPI postcode describes the facility site address, not the operator's registered postcode.

reuse.ext.establishment.name: facility_name is the site/premises name, matching the establishment-owned site name concept.
reuse.ext.establishment.geo: latitude/longitude are facility coordinates, matching the establishment geo point concept (lat,lon).
reuse.entity.abn: abn is the operator's Australian Business Number, matching the business-owned ABN concept; validate checksum.
reuse.entity.acn: acn is the operator's Australian Company Number, matching the business-owned ACN concept; frequently blank.
reuse.entity.legal_name: registered_business_name is the operator/registered business entity name, matching the business legal name concept; it is not the facility name.
reuse.entity.website: facility_website is a published website for the operator/facility, matching the business website concept.

unmapped.reason: Mapped to dyn.establishment.state as the facility site address state; it duplicates jurisdiction_code for these rows but is kept separate so the site address state is not conflated with the NPI registration jurisdiction.
